element_description.description: a detailed descriptions of which element to click on. This description should be at least a full sentence.

num_clicks.description: number of times to click the element

button_type.description: which mouse button to press can be "left", "middle", or "right"

hold_keys.description: list of keys to hold while clicking

function.name: switch_window
function.description: Switch to a different application window by its window ID and maximize it.

window_id.description: the window ID to switch to (e.g., "0x03400006").

function.name: close_window
function.description: Close a window by its window ID. If no window ID is provided, closes the currently active/focused window.

window_id.description: Optional window ID to close (e.g., "0x03400006"). If not provided, closes the current window.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Open an application, Or open a file/folder with an application, then activate and maximize the window.

app_name.description: the name of the application to open. Supported applications include: 'visual_studio_code', 'google_chrome', 'chromium', 'firefox', 'libreoffice_writer', 'libreoffice_calc', 'libreoffice_impress', 'text_editor', 'files', 'terminal', 'thunderbird_mail', 'gui_image_manipulation_program', 'vlc_media_player', 'photo_viewer', 'pdf_viewer'. Please give the exact name as listed.

path.description: optional absolute path to a file or folder to open with the application. The path must exist on the VM. Supported by all apps except Terminal. Examples: open a document with LibreOffice Writer, open a folder as workspace with Visual Studio Code, open an image with GIMP, or open a video with VLC.

function.name: type
function.description: Type text into a specific element

element_description.description: a detailed description of which element to enter text in. This description should be at least a full sentence.

overwrite.description: Default to True. Assign it to False if the text should be appended to the existing text, otherwise assign it to True.

enter.description: Assign it to True if the enter key should be pressed after typing the text, otherwise assign it to False.

function.name: drag_and_drop
function.description: Drag from the starting description to the ending description

starting_description.description: a very detailed description of where to start the drag action. This description should be at least a full sentence.

ending_description.description: a very detailed description of where to end the drag action. This description should be at least a full sentence.

hold_keys.description: list of keys to hold while dragging

function.name: scroll
function.description: Scroll the element in the specified direction

element_description.description: a very detailed description of which element to enter scroll in. This description should be at least a full sentence.

clicks.description: the number of clicks to scroll can be positive (up) or negative (down).

shift.description: whether to use shift+scroll for horizontal scrolling

keys.description: the keys to press in combination in a list format (e.g. ['ctrl', 'c'])

function.name: hold_and_press
function.description: Hold a list of keys and press a list of keys

press_keys.description: list of keys to press in a sequence

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait for a specified amount of time

time.description: the amount of time to wait in seconds
